stem: The lost sales estimate says a store missed 40 units of a laptop during a stockout. A director wants to report 40 × the average selling price as "revenue we lost". What should the analyst add?

options.text: Nothing: taking the rate from in-stock days makes the estimate exact
A note that it is an estimate: some buyers chose another model or came back
A cut by the stockout rate first, since only the stockout days are in the estimate
A cut of the figure by half, since most buyers wait for the new stock
